items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible work that preserves consent, cookie/analytics disclosures, affiliate disclosures, provenance and rights, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data boundaries. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing evidence and containment work. Evidence: Woot public terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; 0 of 4 launch-readiness legal tasks are closed; accuracy/freshness, security, measurement, and attribution gates remain incomplete; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Revenue covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission assigned to an unattributed provider row. No revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claim is supported. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. Partial progress is limited to official Woot-source evidence, repository/configuration artifacts, and privacy/cookie-policy artifacts; none supports task closure. Open tasks: searchwoot-legal-source-rights, searchwoot-data-flow-retention, searchwoot-ga4-consent-evidence, and searchwoot-logs-vendors-incident. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives/alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures. Close no task without attached evidence and satisfied non-legal gates.

Data-use review: Woot API deal and price-history data—counsel_required. Missing evidence: written permission or API agreement; field-level provenance and rights; permitted storage, caching, display, derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, trademark, image, price, affiliate, and advertising terms. Smallest next action: complete the field-level rights matrix and route the unsent permission package for human-counsel review. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed. Missing evidence: data inventory, retention, deletion, correction, access, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe behavior. Smallest next action: produce the repository and deployed data-flow and retention table. GA4 analytics—evidence_needed. Missing evidence: deployed consent and withdrawal behavior, GA4 property/data-sharing settings, retention settings, and jurisdictional treatment. Smallest next action: capture existing consent and GA4 configuration without enabling tracking or advertising. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed. Missing evidence: log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor/DPA review, incident handling, and data-request procedures. Smallest next action: produce a read-only operator/vendor inventory and identify counsel-required gaps.

Site and checklist triage: retain site-specific gates. complicated.work is reachable but fails banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 checks; retain parked status until remediated. deadlymaracas.com is unreachable by DNS with unknown compliance status; retain parked status and require a concrete reachability, disclosure, consent, analytics, terms, monetization, and launch-decision checklist before any launch step. Analytics permission errors and partial attribution require repair or reconciliation where material but do not independently block ordinary growth. No fleet-wide legal clearance or go-live proposal is supported.
